adjudication.rationale: The diff shows in app/controllers/groups_controller.rb lines 22-23: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` followed by `members = group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)`. The limit parameter comes directly from user input with no upper bound validation. A malicious request with `?limit=999999999` would cause the database to attempt to load an unbounded number of records, which are then serialized via `serialize_data(members, GroupUserSerializer)`. This is a real security/DoS vulnerability - the code accepts arbitrary user input for the limit without capping it to a reasonable maximum value.
